definitions.gloss: banquet, formal dinner party, state dinner
definitions.explanation: A formal evening dinner event, typically hosted by governments, organizations, or dignitaries to honor guests or celebrate occasions. Often associated with diplomatic and state functions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国賓|こくひん}→国賓：12137_kokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A state dinner was held for the visiting dignitary.

examples.japanese: {晩餐会|ばんさんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦ゲスト→ゲスト：10849_gesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: More than one hundred guests were invited to the banquet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友好|ゆうこう}→友好：03644_yuukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強調|きょうちょう}した→強調する：21684_kyouchousuru⟧。
examples.english: The president gave a speech at the palace banquet, emphasizing friendship between the two nations.

notes:
USAGE:
{晩餐会|ばんさんかい} refers to a formal dinner event, typically in diplomatic, governmental, or high-society contexts. It is more formal than a simple ⟦{食事会|しょくじかい}→食事会：23547_shokujikai⟧ (dinner party) or ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧ (banquet/party).

In Japanese news, {晩餐会|ばんさんかい} most often appears in reporting on state visits and diplomatic events, such as ⟦{宮中|きゅうちゅう}→宮中：12653_kyuuchuu⟧{晩餐会|ばんさんかい} (an Imperial Palace banquet).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晩餐会|ばんさんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a banquet
- {晩餐会|ばんさんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend a banquet
- ⟦{宮中|きゅうちゅう}→宮中：12653_kyuuchuu⟧{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}: Imperial Palace banquet
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧{晩餐会|ばんさんかい}: official state dinner
